headline: Stellantis Sues Unifor Over Alleged Trespass at Sold Ontario Auto Plant
summary: Automaker Stellantis filed a lawsuit against Canadian union Unifor in an Ontario court, alleging unlawful obstruction at its Brampton facility. Stellantis previously sold the plant to defense contractor Roshel.
why: Stellantis is a major multinational automaker operating manufacturing plants across North America.

impacts.name: Stellantis N.V.
impacts.why: Stellantis sued Unifor alleging illegal obstruction at its Brampton auto facility.
